system.description: You burn an item that belonged to a dead person.

outcomes.triumph: You may ask four questions instead of three.
outcomes.success: You pull the lingering echo of the dead person into the room, looking as if made of shimmering oil. It must answer three questions truthfully.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the item burns, and no one comes.
outcomes.ruin: Someone comes, but it is not them. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
